maddeler.e:
نستوحش (form X)
# نَسْتَوْحِشُ (nastawḥišu) /nas.taw.ħi.ʃu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْحَشَ (istawḥaša)
# نَسْتَوْحِشَ (nastawḥiša) /nas.taw.ħi.ʃa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَوْحَشَ (istawḥaša)
# نَسْتَوْحِشْ (nastawḥiš) /nas.taw.ħiʃ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَوْحَشَ (istawḥaša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
